parts.label: Shell
parts.note: The outer vessel; the cold fluid flows inside it

parts.label: Tubes
parts.note: Hot fluid inside; heat passes through the tube walls

parts.label: Baffles
parts.note: Make the shell fluid zigzag across the tubes

parts.label: Tube sheet
parts.note: Holds and seals the tube ends

parts.note: Enters the head and flows through the tubes

parts.label: Hot fluid out
parts.note: Leaves cooler after giving up heat

parts.label: Cold fluid out
parts.note: Leaves warmer after taking up heat
